headline: RIR Power Electronics files AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: RIR Power Electronics Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026. This routine filing completes the post-meeting compliance process for the company. Indian retail shareholders can review the passed resolutions and voting patterns on the stock exchanges.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate impact on stock price.
